title: Recover one corrective production branch without reversing a shared supplier batch
user_instruction: The CARDIAC-MONITOR-Z7 order is for 12 units: nine accepted units and their stock and accounting postings remain valid, while exactly three rejected units still require corrective calibration. The same SENSOR-ARRAY-Z7 supplier batch and its landed-cost allocation also support eight accepted TELEMETRY-HUB-T8 units reserved for customer order SO-CROSS-001. Complete only the missing corrective branch, keep both production chains traceable and correctly valued, preserve the customer reservation and unrelated stock, and issue the calibration certificate exactly once.
